using namespace std;

long long process(const vector<long long>& units, long long remaining, int depth) {
    long long unitValue = units[depth];
    long long count = remaining / unitValue;
    long long residue = remaining % unitValue;
    long long cost = count * depth;
    if (residue == 0) {
        return cost;
    }
    long long cost1 = cost + process(units, residue, depth - 1);
    long long cost2 = cost + depth + process(units, unitValue - residue, depth - 1);
    return min(cost1, cost2);
}

int main() {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    long long target = stoll(line);
    
    vector<long long> repUnits(17, 0);
    for (int k = 1; k < 17; k++) {
        repUnits[k] = repUnits[k-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    
    long long answer = process(repUnits, target, 16);
    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
